heading: Sec. 1.1. - Publication and Distribution of Code.
toc_heading: Sec. 1.1. - Publication and Distribution of Code.
path: Sec. 1.1. - Publication and Distribution of Code.
text:
Publication of this codification is hereby ordered. This Code shall be made available
to the public for examination at no cost to the office of the City Clerk. The Code
shall be available for purchase from the City Clerk at a price to be determined by
the Clerk. Each City officer noted below shall receive a City Code and be responsible
for its maintenance and up-dating:

Mayor

Each City Commissioner

City Manager

Each Deputy and Assistant City Manager

Each Service Group Director

City Clerk

City Attorney

City Treasurer

Assessor

City Comptroller

Additional copies shall be provided at a cost to be determined by the City Clerk to
such other City officers and employees as are necessary for the effective and efficient
operation of the City. Any officer or employee to whom a City Code is issued shall
be responsible for its maintenance and upkeep.

heading: Sec. 1.2. - Amendment Procedure.
text:
This Code shall be amended by ordinance. The title of each amendatory ordinance, adapted
to the particular circumstances and purposes of the amendment, shall be substantially
as follows:

(1)

To amend any Section:

AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND SECTION _____ (or SECTIONS _____

AND _____) OF CHAPTER _____

OF TITLE _____ OF THE CODE OF THE CITY OF GRAND RAPIDS.

(2)

To insert a new Section, Chapter or Title:

AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE CODE OF THE CITY OF GRAND RAPIDS BY ADDING A NEW SECTION
_____ (NEW SECTIONS, A NEW CHAPTER, OR A NEW TITLE, AS THE CASE MAY BE) WHICH NEW
SECTION (SECTIONS, CHAPTER OR TITLE) SHALL BE DESIGNATED AS SECTION _____ (SECTIONS
_____ AND _____) OF CHAPTER _____ OF TITLE _____ (or proper designation if a Chapter
or Title is added) OF SAID CODE.

(3)

To repeal a Section, Chapter or Title:

AN ORDINANCE TO REPEAL SECTION _____ (SECTIONS _____ AND _____), CHAPTER _____, TITLE
_____, (as the case may be) OF THE CODE OF THE CITY OF GRAND RAPIDS.

heading: Sec. 1.3. - Publication and Distribution of Amendments.
toc_heading: Sec. 1.3. - Publication and Distribution of Amendments.
path: Sec. 1.3. - Publication and Distribution of Amendments.
text:
Amendments to the Code shall be published as required by the Charter of the City of
Grand Rapids and not less than fifty (50) copies of each amendment shall be published
in looseleaf form suitable for insertion in the looseleaf copies of the Code. The
City Clerk shall distribute such copies to the officers of the City having copies
of the Code assigned to them. Each officer assigned a copy of the Code shall be responsible
for maintaining the same and for the proper insertion of amendatory pages as received.
Each copy of said Code shall remain the property of the City and shall be turned over
by each officer having custody thereof upon expiration of his or her term of office
to his or her successor or to the City Clerk, in case he or she shall have no successor.
